description: Volunteer's Battlegear Bring 5 Cenarion Combat Badges, 3 Cenarion Logistics Badges and 7 Cenarion Tactical Badges to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also attain Friendly reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.
